name: L51 Developments Bridle Road Bootle data centre
notes: EIA screening/preliminary plans submitted to Sefton Council for a two-block, three-storey data centre off Bridle Road, Bootle; target full operation reported as 2029 if approvals proceed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ASK4 DC1 Sheffield
notes: Public data-centre directory lists ASK4 DC1 at Morgan House, 9 Brompton Road, Sheffield, launched in 2011 and operational; directory capacity listed as 1.5 MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital NHS Trust data centre refurbishment
developer: Shrewsbury and Telford Hospital NHS Trust; Sudlows
notes: Sudlows case study reports delivery of a modernised Shrewsbury data centre facility for SaTH, with reciprocal backup duplicated at Princess Royal Hospital; listed power is 60 kW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Yondr London campus, Slough
notes: DCD reports Yondr reached first ready-for-service milestone for the third facility on its 100 MW Slough campus; first 40 MW and second 30 MW buildings had previously launched.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Equinix AkzoNobel/Wexham Road Slough data centre campus
notes: Slough Borough Council planning committee granted permission for a data centre campus on about half of the former AkzoNobel paint factory site; Equinix still needed detailed applications for appearance, scale and landscaping.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Equinix LD14, Banbury Avenue
notes: Equinix planned a new 30MW+ data centre on Slough Trading Estate, later reported as having gained planning permission in 2023 and to be known as LD14.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: SEGRO Bath Road Slough data centres
notes: Slough Borough Council approved demolition of six Bath Road buildings for two data centres of about 324,316 sq ft and 534,966 sq ft; technical capacity and schedule were not published.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Global Technical Realty / SEGRO Ajax Avenue Slough data centres
notes: DCD reported GTR broke ground on a 40.5MW Slough Trading Estate data centre in January 2022; SEGRO's March 2026 asset-tour deck states the Ajax Avenue case study completed three multi-level data centres in December 2023 and leased them to GTR.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: CyrusOne London III, Slough Trading Estate
notes: DCD reported CyrusOne's London III facility on Slough Trading Estate would provide 9MW of IT load and was due for completion by Q4 2019; treated as operational unless later contrary evidence emerges.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Midlands AI Supercluster Solihull AI Data Centre Campus
developer: Midlands AI Growth Zone / project sponsors not stated
notes: Project website lists Solihull as one of five proposed Midlands AI Supercluster locations, with an AI data centre campus and 600MW capacity; no planning application or named operator found in quick public search.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Somerset Data Centre, Horsey near Bridgwater
notes: Express Distribution Park, via Lichfields, requested Somerset Council EIA scoping for a 130ha, 250,000 sqm multi-building campus at Horsey; public reports say council approved the initial screening/scoping request and capacity could reach 500MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Isambard-AI modular data centre, Bristol & Bath Science Park
notes: 5MW Isambard-AI supercomputer went live at the Bristol Centre for Supercomputing/National Composites Centre on Bristol & Bath Science Park in Emersons Green, South Gloucestershire; housed in a low-carbon modular data centre.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: University of Bristol National AI Data Facility
notes: University of Bristol announced a multi-million-pound National AI Data Facility at the National Composites Centre, Bristol & Bath Science Park, next to Isambard-AI; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

name: University Hospital Southampton Laundry Road data centre
developer: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust
notes: Southampton council approved plans for a one-storey purpose-built data centre building at 89 Laundry Road next to the hospital; timeline and IT capacity were not disclosed.
